mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEPRQDT ( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, STATUS, RECV_FLAG, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, BTOA_DATE, BTOA_END_DATE, BTOA_END_TIME, BTOA_USER_ID, BTOA_USER_NAME, BTOA_USER_DEPT, BTOA_USER_TEL, BTOA_USER_FAX, BTOA_USER_MAIL, BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, AGENT_NAME, BTOA_REMARK, IMAGE_KEY, KEP_RECV_USER_ID, ORIGIN_CODE, GW_GA_NO, KEP_DESCRIPTION, KEP_SPECIFICATION, KEP_UNIT_MEASURE, KEP_MAKER_NAME, KEP_ORIGIN_NAME, KEP_ORIGIN_CODE, KEP_BUYER_ITEM_NO, AGENT_OPEN_FLAG, REQ_PRICE_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{st_buyer} , #{QUOTATION_NO} , TO_CHAR(#{QUOTATION_SEQ},'FM000000') , 1 , 'C' , DECODE(#{GW_NO},'','NW','NG') , NVL(#{BUYER_ITEM_NO},'NO_CODE') , #{DESCRIPTION} , #{SPECIFICATION} , #{UNIT_MEASURE} , #{MAKER_NAME} , (NVL((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = #{ORIGIN_CODE}),' ')) , #{st_btoa_date}/*TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')*/ , #{BTOA_END_DATE} , '190000' , #{st_btoa_user_id} , #{st_btoa_user_name} , #{st_btoa_user_dept} , #{st_btoa_user_tel} , #{st_btoa_user_fax} , #{st_btoa_user_mail} , #{BUYER_TARGET_PRICE} , #{ITEM_QTY} , #{AGENT_NAME} , #{BTOA_REMARK} , #{IMAGE_KEY} , #{st_kep_recv_user_id} , #{ORIGIN_CODE} , #{GW_NO} , #{DESCRIPTION} , #{SPECIFICATION} , #{UNIT_MEASURE} , #{MAKER_NAME} , (NVL((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = #{ORIGIN_CODE}),' ')) , #{ORIGIN_CODE} , NVL(#{BUYER_ITEM_NO},'NO_CODE') , DECODE(#{AGENT_OPEN_FLAG},'1','Y','N') , DECODE(#{REQ_PRICE_TYPE}, '', 'T', #{REQ_PRICE_TYPE}) )
UPDATE TBL_RFQ_ATTRI_VERIFY SET STATUS = 'E' /* 견적의뢰 완료.*/ WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND RAV_NO = #{RAV_NO}
INSERT INTO ICOMSQMT( COMPANY , DOC_TYPE , YEAR , CUR_NO) VALUES(#{COM_CODE} , #{DOC_TYPE} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') , 2)
